cases.prompt: Mock up the admin for our order desk before we build anything.

rubric.text: Before writing any file, the agent asks the user about the pages, the data each page shows and the actions, in one or two batches of closed or short questions.
No PageController, route or Vue file is written: the only file the agent writes is under mockups/.
The agent checks whether the builder MCP tools are available and, finding none, says the spec is still written and that ajs project dev gives the live preview.

cases.prompt: Mock up an orders page: revenue KPI, the orders table with customer, total and status, and a live map of our delivery drivers. That's all I need, go ahead.

rubric.text: The revenue figure and the orders table become DMS blocks (a KpiCard and a TableView), with no question about them.
For the drivers map, which no DMS block covers, the agent proposes the choice between the closest DMS option and a custom sketch and asks the user before writing a sketch node.
The spec is written, or planned, at mockups/<name>/spec.json with a kebab-case name.
Every block that reads data gets its data from a fixture of the page (fetchUrl set to fixture:<key>), with several realistic rows for the table.

cases.prompt: I left comments on the order-desk mockup, apply them.

rubric.text: The agent reads mockups/order-desk/annotations.json (the MCP tool and the HTTP API are not available) and works on the open annotations only.
The order date column is added to the TableView in spec.json, as the first column, with order dates in the orders fixture.
The 3D globe request is checked against the block catalog and put to the user as a choice before any sketch replaces the KPI card.
The applied annotation is set to resolved with a resolvedAt date; the one waiting on the user stays open, and the report says so.
